name: totalfusion-tutorial-02
description: Tutorial 2: run the code of third parties in the sandbox of WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:rules && npm run build:hostile
scripts.build:rules: cd rules && GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm go build -buildmode=c-shared -o ../plugins/rules.wasm .
scripts.build:hostile: cd hostile && GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm go build -buildmode=c-shared -o ../plugins/hostile.wasm .
